content_sections.heading: SVBPH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SVBPH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SVBPH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Resident : MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/ DNB/ Diploma as per residency scheme in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/ Institution., Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Resident : Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable: SC/ST: 05 years, OBC: 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SVBPH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of SVBPH?
faq.answer: SVBPH stands for Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Hospital, a prominent healthcare institution located in New Delhi, Delhi, which frequently recruits medical professionals for various resident positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted for the post of Senior Resident across multiple specialized medical departments within the hospital.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Senior Resident position across departments such as Obs & Gynae, Surgery, Pathology, and Paediatrics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline through a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates must report directly to the venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 05-10-2026. Candidates need to report for enrollment between 9.00 A.M. and 10.30 A.M.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree, DNB, or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized university, alongside a valid Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is set below 45 years, with permissible age relaxations provided for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic salary of Rs. 67,700/- per month in Pay Matrix Level 11 of the 7th CPC, along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for attending this walk-in interview. All categories of candidates are completely exempted from fee payment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website details?
faq.answer: You can access further updates, details, and notifications directly by visiting the official hospital website at https://svbph.delhi.gov.in.
